module: Unisys Linux Kernel Cryptographic API Module
caveat: When installed, initialized and configured as specified in the Security Policy Section 11
description: The Unisys Linux Kernel Cryptographic API Module is a software-only cryptographic module that comprises a set of Linux kernel modules. It provides general purpose cryptographic services to the remainder of the Linux kernel.
tested_configurations: and Ubuntu 12.04 LTS distribution with Vmware ESXi 5.5 running on a Dell PowerEdge R820 with PAA and with PCLMULQDQ and SSSE3 (single-user mode)
